# FQHELatticeCompositeFermions

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnLattice` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnLattice/FQHELatticeCompositeFermions`

```text
FQHELatticeCompositeFermions, version 0.01

Usage: FQHELatticeCompositeFermions [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 3)

    -q, --flux : number of flux quanta piercing the lattice  (default value = 6)

    -c, --hard-core : Use Hilbert-space of hard-core bosons
    --solenoid-flux : twist in periodic boundary conditions for total wavefunction phi_x[,phi_y])
    -s, --solenoid-CF : twist in periodic boundary conditions for CF part phi_x[,phi_y])
    --CF : externally supply single particle states for CF basis (base)
    --all-CF : externally supply single particle states (list of full file-names)
    --J : externally supply single particle states for Jastrow basis (base)

optimization options:
    --optimize : vector file to optimize CF solenoid flux against

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:
    --fast-search : amount of memory that can be allocated for fast state search (in Mbytes) (default value = 9)

misc options:
    -d, --omit-diag : omit diagonalizing in momentum basis
    -a, --analytic : also generate the analytic wavefunctions
    --write-basis : write the single particle basis states that were used
    --write-product : write the product states of pairs of basis states
    --write-slater : write the slater determinant part of the wavefunction
    --write-jastrow : write the jastrow factor part of the wavefunction
    -o, --output-file : redirect output to this file
```
